A '''wing''' was a rigid horizontal structure that projected from both sides of the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or aircraft. It produced the lift for rising the vehicle into the air.<ref name="TOR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170620|text=Cartel Market Specials: Week of June 19, 2017}}</ref>
